# Foundation for Economic Education (FEE)

> FEE is a leading educational organization promoting free market principles, economic literacy, and classical liberal thought through fellowships, seminars, media content, and classroom resources.

The Foundation for Economic Education provides comprehensive economics education through intensive programs like the Hazlitt Fellowship and Summer Campus, alongside accessible content via articles, videos, and podcasts. FEE reaches students, educators, and the general public with libertarian perspectives on policy, education innovation, and economic analysis.

## Key Topics

- Free Market Economics
- Classical Liberalism
- Economics Education

## Flagship Educational Programs

- [Hazlitt Fellowship](https://fee.org/hazlitt-fellowship): Intensive 3-month fellowship developing emerging scholars into content creators
- [Summer Campus](https://fee.org/summer-campus): Summer Campus at University of Maryland teaching economics and classical liberalism
- [FEE Seminar Series](https://fee.org/seminars): FEE Seminar Series offering economics and classical liberal education to students
- [FEE Hackathon](https://fee.org/hackathon): Annual hackathon in Las Vegas for college students building AI-powered solutions

## Educational Resources & Classroom Tools

- [Classroom](https://fee.org/classroom): Teaching resources and classroom programs for economics and financial literacy
- [Why One School District Is Launching New Microschool-Inspired Classrooms](https://fee.org/articles/why-one-school-district-is-launching-new-microschool-inspired-classrooms): Article on microschool innovation and alternative education in public schools

## Content & Media

- [Shows](https://fee.org/shows): Video shows and podcasts including FEExplains and Common Sense Soapbox
- [Analysis & Opinion](https://fee.org/articles): Archive of economic analysis and opinion commentary on free market topics
- [Commentary](https://fee.org/commentary): Commentary section featuring opinion articles on economics and policy

## Economic Analysis & Policy

- [Wage Wars](https://fee.org/articles/wage-wars): Analysis of Spain's minimum wage policy increases and employment effects
- [Malaysia's Resurgence](https://fee.org/articles/malaysias-resurgence): Article on Malaysia's economic growth and semiconductor industry development
- [Monaco's Unlikely Savior](https://fee.org/articles/monacos-unlikely-savior): Historical analysis of Monaco's gambling economy and libertarian tax policy
